page_summary: This page serves as the cover for the World Bank report titled 'Cybersecurity in Ports: Shifting from Risk to Resilience.' It features a digital illustration of port infrastructure, including ships and cranes, integrated with cybersecurity elements such as shields. The design emphasizes the theme of cybersecurity in the maritime sector.

regions.label: Cover Image
regions.description: A digital illustration depicting port infrastructure with ships and cranes, overlaid with cybersecurity elements like shields, symbolizing the integration of cybersecurity in ports.
